verdict.rationale: Zapier's Visual Builder is documented as a no-code interface for building multi-step Zap workflows, explicitly positioned for non-developers ('quick deployment and collaboration across teams, even without developer expertise'), and community evidence corroborates non-technical/ops users successfully building workflows themselves. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review specifically walking through multi-step visual editing (community evidence focuses more on general ease-of-use and pricing than a detailed multi-step build).
